question: The second Lok Sabha was constituted in:
solution:
The correct answer is **__1957__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The second Lok Sabha was constituted in 1957.
 
• The **Speaker **of the second Lok Sabha was **Shri Ananthasayanam Ayyangar**(11/5/1957 - 16/4/1962).
 
• Deputy Speaker was Sardar Humam Singh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first Lok Sabha was constituted in 1952.
 
• After India's first general election, the First Lok Sabha was constituted on 17 April 1952.
 
• The First Session is Lok Sabha began on May 13, 1952.
 
• The Lok Sabha must have elected and non-elected members, as provided for in Article 93 of the Constitution of India.
 
• The first speaker of Lok Sabha was Ganesh Vasudev Mavlankar who elected on 8th May 1952.
 
• The first leader of the house was Jahawar Lal Nehru who elected on 30th May 1952.
